title: The Effect of Government Reference Bonds on Corporate Borrowing Costs: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
authors: Mark Jeffrey Flannery; Claire Yurong Hong; Baolian Wang
eligible_reason: Single event: China's Oct 2017 USD sovereign issuance (announcement 11 Oct 2017). Main tables are cross-sectional regressions of bond yield changes around the event on usd (USD vs RMB bonds) and maturity buckets with issuer controls; sensitivity, mutual-fund holding and issuance tables use a common after/post indicator. Not staggered.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe/areg plus SAS. Bond-level Bloomberg samples (553 USD corporate bonds), CSMAR RMB bonds, Morningstar holdings.
data_files_note: readme.docx: Bloomberg/CSMAR licensed data shipped with masked bond IDs.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract. Single common event; not a DiD candidate.
